errors.text_span: Im ersten Diagramm befindet sich eine blaue durchgezogene Linie, die den IWF-Fiskalindex darstellt
errors.evidence: In the figure, the blue solid line in the first panel is a line series on the left axis, but the IWF fiscal index is represented by the right-axis triangular marker series; the blue line corresponds to the left-axis fiscal-rule index values, not the debt quota.

errors.text_span: und die rote Dreiecke vorhanden, die die Schuldenquote des Gesamtstaats darstellen
errors.evidence: The red triangles in the first panel are not the debt quota line; the triangular markers are a separate series on the left-axis scale, while the debt quota is shown by the magenta/purple solid line on the right axis.

errors.text_span: Das zweite Diagramm zeigt eine blaue durchgezogene Linie für den IWF-Fiskalindex
errors.evidence: In the second panel, the blue solid line is the left-axis fiscal-rule index series, but the IWF fiscal index is represented by the triangular marker series on the left axis; the description swaps the line with the marker series.

errors.text_span: Es sind außerdem rote Dreiecke vorhanden, die die Schuldenquote der Zentralregierung darstellen
errors.evidence: In the second panel, the red triangles are not the debt quota line; the debt quota is the magenta/purple solid line on the right axis, while the red triangles are a separate left-axis series.

errors.text_span: die bei etwa 40 im Jahr 1995 beginnen
errors.evidence: In the first panel the red triangle series starts near 55, not 40.
The first-panel red triangle series is around the high 70s to about 80 by 2007, not 60.

errors.text_span: und dann bis etwa 40 im Jahr 2012 zurückgehen
errors.evidence: The first-panel red triangle series is around 80 by 2012, not 40.
The first-panel red triangle series is around 100 by 2020, not 65.

errors.text_span: die bei etwa 0,3 im Jahr 1995 beginnt
errors.evidence: In the second panel, the blue line starts slightly below 0, around -0.1, not 0.3.
The second-panel blue line peaks around 1.0 at 2010, not 1.1.

errors.text_span: dann bis etwa 0,4 im Jahr 2012 abnimmt
errors.evidence: The second-panel blue line is around 0.9 in 2012, not 0.4.
The second-panel blue line ends around 0.6 in 2020, not 1.5.

errors.text_span: die bei etwa -5 im Jahr 1995 beginnt
errors.evidence: The second-panel red triangle series starts around 32–33, not -5.
The second-panel red triangle series is around 46–47 in 2010, not 50.
The second-panel red triangle series is around 48–49 in 2012, not 40.
The second-panel red triangle series is around 50 in 2020, not 70.

The description omits the actual marker shapes and color coding of the right-axis series, especially the magenta/purple solid debt-quota line and the blue/red triangle marker series shown in both panels.
